items.title: Vertiv (NYSE:VRT) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q2 CY2026 Earnings, Stock Drops 10.4%
items.summary: Data center products and services company Vertiv (NYSE:VRT) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 24.1% year on year to $3.27 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s outlook exceeded expectations with revenue guided to $3.75 billion at the midpoint, or 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.52 per share was 6.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
